approved_money._three_amounts_not_two: all_in_usd bounds ONE session and equals gpu_hard_usd + disk_hard_usd. campaign_all_in_usd is CUMULATIVE across every run attempt and provider resource of this campaign, including settled spend, and is the only figure campaign_continuation_gate charges prior spend against. stage_envelope_all_in_usd is the maintainer's 2026-09-23 allowance for ALL remaining C2 work including supporting engineering infrastructure outside the formal campaign -- the probe pre-staging is on it, not on the campaign ceiling.
approved_money._the_session_ceiling_is_shortened: a fresh session derives to $33.2099 over 1800.53 minutes. This campaign has settled $22.2466 of its $42.0 ceiling, so the session is authorized for $19.7533 over 1070.96 minutes -- what the campaign has left, floored. Nothing scientific is shortened: the work owes 491.51 minutes.
approved_money._basis: the reviewed proposal basis at a quoted L40S securePrice of $1.09/h. Issuance re-quotes the live securePrice and derives the SESSION terms mechanically from it. The campaign ceiling is not a function of the rate and no re-quote may move it.
approved_money._the_working_set_is_consumer_derived: this continuation moves 8.1 MiB of descriptors, scores, per-sample rows and hashes -- not 22.21 GiB of checkpoints. Ten completed probes are validly scored, so no remaining authorized operation reads their weights.

live_rate_issuance_rule: derive the authorization terms mechanically from that live rate
bind rate_usd_per_hour, hard_runtime_minutes, gpu_hard_usd, disk_hard_usd and all_in_hard_usd distinctly
retain the reviewed scientific runtime and work scope
do not shorten the scientific experiment merely because the provider price increased
do not extend runtime or work because the provider price decreased
if the live quote materially changes the dollar authorization from the reviewed basis, STOP and return to the maintainer before creating the provider resource
a provider-returned rate above the authorized rate must refuse and tear down under the existing fail-closed contract
_one_use_is_per_chain: this grant authorizes ONE launch chain. A replacement resource inside the same campaign is a new run attempt with a fresh chain, permitted under R1-R10 and bounded by the SAME cumulative campaign ceiling above -- not by a new allocation.

provider_placement._why_constrained: this campaign's ten completed probes are pre-staged on network volume 59qt99zeg5, which lives in EU-NL-1 and can be attached only from there. The constraint is the price of not paying an accelerator to receive 22.21 GiB during the session.

autonomous_engineering_repair.permitted: inside this scientific scope, the $42.0000 cumulative campaign ceiling and the $25.00 stage envelope, ordinary engineering failures are handled autonomously: preserve evidence, confirm teardown and non-billing, diagnose, minimal repair, focused regression, fresh run identity and chain where required, continue. No approval is needed after each ordinary failure, and an aborted pre-science launcher invocation is an engineering subrun rather than a retried experiment.
stop_and_return_if: the $25.00 remaining-C2 stage envelope cannot cover a minimum credible path to completion
the frozen scientific question becomes unanswerable without changing the hypothesis, arms, endpoint, battery, seed design or decision rule
a necessary irreversible action would destroy unique historical or frozen evidence
human authentication, account or payment interaction is physically required and cannot be completed here

on_identity_mismatch: an arm whose rebuilt digest does not match the frozen record is a SCIENTIFIC FINDING and a stop condition, not a retryable engineering failure. The path is deterministic and would diverge identically on a retry. Preserve, tear down, and return it to review unchanged.
execution_chain: final live quote and all pre-provider gates
